failureModes: No Notion contact changes in canonical CRM
Untrusted webhook or duplicate events could bypass controls
False-green SalesRobot reachability without executable subscription or eligible recipients
prevention: Reuse bg-notion-sync and bg_connecties without another sender
HMAC-verify raw Notion events and retrieve current Notion page
Do not create prospects, infer consent or send LinkedIn DMs from Notion labels
Keep release and external provider proofs independent
